tail: He who blessed our fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, bless all this holy congregation together with all other holy congregations; them, their wives, sons and daughters

and all that belong to them; those who set aside synagogues for prayer and those who come to pray in them; those who provide light for illumination, wine for Kiddush and Havdalah, bread for strangers, charity for the poor; and all those who occupy themselves faithfully with the affairs of the community. May the Holy One, blessed be He, pay their reward, avert from them all illness, heal all their body, forgive all their guilt and send blessing and success for all the work of their hands and that of all Israel, their brethren, and let us say: Amen.
